name: @pipeworx/mcp-cipo

tools.name: search_cipo_patents
tools.description: Search the Canadian Patents Database (CIPO) by owner or applicant name and get back matching Canadian patents/applications — number, title, relevance. Covers every patent and application in CIPO's database, Canadian and foreign-origin alike, as long as it was filed or granted in Canada. Use "role":"applicant" to search the party that filed the application, or "role":"owner" to search the current owner of record (these can differ after an assignment). Follow up with get_patent for status, filing date and issue date on any hit.

name.description: Company or individual name to search for, e.g. "Shopify Inc." or "Royal Bank of Canada". Multi-word names are matched as a phrase.

role.description: Which party field to search: "owner" (current owner of record) or "applicant" (party that filed). Default "owner".

tools.name: get_cipo_patent
tools.description: Look up one Canadian patent or application by number in the Canadian Patents Database (CIPO) and get its full bibliographic record: title (English/French), current status, filing date, issue/grant date (blank if not yet granted), owners, applicants, inventors and IPC classification. Accepts the number with or without a "CA" prefix, spaces or dashes — digits only, up to 7 digits.

instructions: @pipeworx/mcp-cipo forwards to the Pipeworx gateway and lists only the cipo pack's tools. Set PIPEWORX_META_TOOLS=1 to also list ask_pipeworx and the other gateway-wide tools.
